legend: In application identifies who is currently using the application in this example. Can access means the person can sign in; authentication is still required.

Advisor.explanation: The advisor is preparing or revising the application. Applicant access is available after the advisor sends it.

Applicant.explanation: The advisor can sign in to the saved application and take over at any point before the applicant reaches DocuSign.

DocuSign.explanation: Once the applicant reaches DocuSign, the advisor can no longer access or take over the application. Only the applicant can resume using the application link already sent by the advisor.

Unavailable.explanation: A deleted application cannot be resumed.
